findings.note: Garrett is listed among the sponsors of S641, Fix Our Democracy. The filed text sets up automatic voter registration through driver license and special ID card applications, with the person taking the application asking whether the applicant is a citizen, and treats a stated non-citizen or a person who declines to answer as not registered. Garrett's campaign site names this bill as one he co-sponsored. Date is the date shown on the bill page history; not re-checked against the filing entry.
